task: ae.sketch Bloom filter, Count-Min sketch and HyperLogLog with merge, statistical bounds and sealed serialization
reasoning_summary: Built a shared seeded hash and CRC32 codec, then three sketches with their published sizing formulas. Tests pair exact one-sided guarantees and merge algebra with seeded statistical bounds and exhaustive corruption loops. One test defect (a leftover line overwriting the magic bytes) was fixed on the second attempt; no production code changed.
